simple.meaning: חֲרָדָה (chărâdâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “fear , anxiety.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 9 times in Genesis, 1 Samuel, 2 Kings, Proverbs, Isaiah, and 3 more, beginning at Genesis 27:33. The surrounding contexts include family line, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֲרָדָה (H2731) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: חֲרָדָה (chărâdâh) / H2731 is traced through Genesis 27:33, 1 Samuel 14:15, 2 Kings 4:13, Proverbs 29:25 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H2731. charadah I. חֲרָדָה noun feminine trembling, fear, anxiety — חֲרָדָה Gen 27:33 5 t. + Ezek 38:21 (read for הָרַי , B Co compare Dr 1Sam 14:15 ); construct חֶרְדַּת 14:15 ; Prov 29:25 (see Lag BN 113 ); plural חֲרָדוֺת Ezek 26:16 ; — 1 trembling, quaking (of terror ascribed to supernatural cause) 1Sam 14:15 (twice in verse) (hence ׳ח אלהים see Dr; || וַתִּרְגַּזהֿארץ ) compare Ezek 38:21 (see above); Dan 10:7 ; ח ׳קול Jer 30:5 voice of trembling ; followed by Genitive object ׳ח אָדָם Prov 29:25 trembling before man ; opposed to pleasure Isa 21:4 ; tremblings (plural) Ezek 26:16 under figure of garment ( ׳ח ילבשׁו ), of effect on coast-princes of fall of Tyre. 2 anxious care 2Kin 4:13 , accusative of congnate meaning with verb with חָרַד .
